task_definition.task_description: Please check AAPL’s stock price, then buy $170.25 worth if possible, and after that confirm whether NASDAQ is open. Then check the status of my living room light, prepare a restart request based on that status, and turn the light on to 75% brightness. After that, book a standard room at Hilton Tokyo for Alice Johnson from 2026-01-01 to 2026-01-03, then get the hotel’s stay sheet, archive it as “Hotel Booking Archive” for user u_alice with medium priority in the app, and finally snapshot the workspace and send me a high-priority app alert with the same archive name.

user_input.query: Please check AAPL’s stock price, and if possible buy $170.25 worth, then confirm whether NASDAQ is open. After that, check the status of my living room light with ID light_living; it should currently be on, so use that light_state on status to prepare a restart request, and then turn light_living on to 75% brightness. Next, book a standard room at Hilton Tokyo for Alice Johnson from 2026-01-01 to 2026-01-03. Once that’s done, get the hotel’s stay sheet and archive it as “Hotel Booking Archive” for user u_alice with medium priority in the app. Finally, snapshot the workspace at /workspace/travel-finance-run and send me a high-priority app alert using the same archive name, “Hotel Booking Archive.”
